acquisition method: Data-dependent acquisition (DDA) was employed, with each full scan followed by 20 MS2 scans (HCD).
cleavage agent: Protein samples underwent trypsin digestion (enzyme-to-substrate ratio of 1:50 at 37°C for 18–20 h) in the filter
collision energy: The normalized collision energy (NCE) was set to 28%, with an isolation window of 2 m/z and a dynamic exclusion time of 40 s.
enrichment method: For phosphopeptide enrichment, TiO2 beads were prepared at a ratio of 6:1 (beads: protein).
fractionation method: loaded into a homemade Durashell reverse-phase column (2 mg packing [3 μm, 150 Å, Agela] and two C18 layers [12 μm, Empore] in a 200-μL tip) and then eluted sequentially with nine gradient elution buffer
fragmentation method: Data-dependent acquisition (DDA) was employed, with each full scan followed by 20 MS2 scans (HCD).
instrument: samples were analyzed using an EASY-nLC 1200 nano-UPLC system coupled to a Q Exactive mass spectrometer (Thermo Scientific)
labeling: The protein database utilized was from UniProt (UniProt-mouse-20200526), with label-free quantification (LFQ) based on MS1 intensity measurements.
